item.title: War declared on Trump DOJ's 'abnormal' behavior by fed-up attorneys
item.description: A group of criminal defense attorneys has launched a war against the Trump Department of Justice's "abnormal behavior," according to a report. The lawyers banded together and created a tool called Case Tracker, a database of federal cases in which eyewitness testimony undermines government charges. The tracker is sponsored by The National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, KBPS reported. item.description: A media expert revealed on Wednesday that President Donald Trump's leader at the Federal Communications Commission may have created a situation that will backfire spectacularly. item.title: GOP analysts pan Trump's 'divisive' attack on Black history: 'A bit concerning'
